submissionPeriods.title: Submission periods
submissionPeriods.description: Where each reporting period starts and ends. Changing these takes effect immediately for new submissions and open-period checks; periods already recorded keep the boundaries they were written with.
submissionPeriods.fiscalYearHint: Also anchors quarterly and half-yearly periods.
submissionPeriods.fortnightAnchorHint: Any date on a fortnight boundary; only the date matters.

submissionWindows.title: Submission windows
submissionWindows.description: How long before/after each cadence's period a service may actually create or edit a submission for it. Open offset delays when the window opens after the period starts; Grace period extends how long it stays open after the period ends. Both default to 0 hours — the window is exactly the period — until set here. “Missed submission” reporting and reminders also wait for the grace period to elapse.

currentPeriods.title: Current periods
currentPeriods.description: What the settings above resolve to right now — a live snapshot, not something that updates on its own.

ingestion.title: Ingestion
ingestion.description: A global kill switch for disaster recovery. Closing submissions blocks service-facing ingestion — service accounts, bulk import and the Teams integration — while everything else (reads, OData, admin create/edit for remediation, schemas, settings) stays available. A banner with the message below is shown to everyone while closed.
ingestion.bannerHint: Shown to everyone while submissions are closed.
ingestion.bannerPlaceholder: e.g. Submissions are paused while we investigate a data issue. Expected back up by 5pm UTC.

configBackup.title: Configuration backup
configBackup.description: Export all configuration (approval policy & rules, email & notification settings and templates, webhooks, integrations and the Teams connection) to a single JSON file, or restore it from one — to copy configuration between environments or recover after a disaster.

configBackup.confirmRestore:
Restore from this configuration backup?

This REPLACES all current configuration (approval policy & rules, email & notification settings and templates, webhooks, integrations and the Teams connection) with the contents of the file. It cannot be undone.

Encrypted secrets (SMTP password, webhook secrets, Teams bot secret) only work if this server uses the same ApiKey:Pepper as the one that produced the file; otherwise re-enter them afterwards. A stored secret is kept when the file omits it.
configBackup.warningBeforePepper: and is not transactional. Encrypted secrets are included as ciphertext and only decrypt on a server using the same
configBackup.warningAfterPepper: ; on a different deployment, re-enter them after the restore. A stored secret is preserved when the file omits it.

Import accounts from this file?

Accounts are matched by name: existing ones are updated and new names are created. Accounts not in the file are left untouched.

API keys are NOT included in the file, so any account created by this import starts with no key — generate one for each afterwards.
accountsBackup.warningBeforeNoKey: They aren't stored in a recoverable form, so an imported account starts with
accountsBackup.warningAfterNoKey: and must have one re-generated before it can authenticate. Import is non-destructive — accounts missing from the file are left as they are.

approval.appliesToHint: You can require approval for only manual entries, only API submissions, or both.
approval.approversHint: Pick who may review: the Approver/Admin accounts below, and/or the service owner (the account that sent the submission, so a service can sign off on its own data). Mark at least one as Required; the submission goes live once every Required approver has approved.
approval.globalDefaultHelp: This follows the global default approval policy, configured in Settings — Approval.
approval.heading: Approval
approval.modeHint: Submissions in scope are held as Pending until approved, and excluded from the OData feed and Explore until then. Defaults to no approval for backwards compatibility.
approval.modifiableHelp: Re-submitting data for a window that already has a submission replaces it and resets its approval status to Pending — even if it was previously approved. While it waits for re-approval it drops out of the OData feed and Explore. If you don't want re-submissions to disturb approved data, mark the schema as not modifiable.
approval.modifiableTitle: Heads up: this schema is modifiable
approval.requiredValidation: Add at least one Required approver.

bulkImport.formatHint: Auto-detected from the file extension; override if needed.
bulkImport.help: Import historical submissions for a single service from a JSON or CSV file. Parsing must succeed for the whole file; each submission is then validated and saved independently, so a rejected one won't block the rest. Submissions that already exist are skipped, so re-running the same file is safe.

schemaEdit.schemaMissing: No schema named "{{name}}" exists. It may have been deleted.
schemaEdit.sinceVersionHint: Optional. When set and equal to the schema's current version ({{version}}), the SPA shows a "New" tag next to this value for one cadence period. Leave empty for "always present".
schemaEdit.snapshotHelp: Version {{version}} saved <savedAt /> {{author}}. This is a historical view and cannot be edited — it does not affect the current schema.
schemaEdit.snapshotMissing: This version snapshot no longer exists. It may have been deleted from the history.
schemaEdit.targetBandHelp: Reporting-only Red/Amber/Green ranges shown as shaded bands on charts — never enforced. The acceptable (amber) range is the outer band; the ideal (green) range sits inside it. Outside the amber range is red. Each edge is optional, but a green edge needs the matching amber edge on the same side, and edges must read low-to-high: amber min ≤ green min ≤ green max ≤ amber max.
schemaEdit.validationPlaceholder: e.g. if(expenses > revenue, 'expenses cannot exceed revenue', null)
schemaEdit.validationsHint: Each rule runs once per submission against every value in the schema. Add several to enforce multiple cross-value invariants.
schemaEdit.valueNameFixed: The name is fixed after creation — it is referenced by validation rules and existing submissions. Add a new value if you need a different name.
schemaEdit.valueNameHint: Used as the identifier in validation rules. Must start with a letter or underscore and contain only letters, digits, and underscores.
schemaEdit.valueNameValidation: Must be a valid identifier: letters, digits and underscores only; cannot start with a digit.
schemaEdit.valueValidationHint: Runs against the submitted sample. Vars include value, minimum, maximum. Whitespace and line breaks are ignored.
schemaEdit.versionHint: Bump when introducing new values. Cannot decrease. Each value's 'Since version' must be ≤ this.
schemaEdit.visibleIfHint: When false (or null) the value is hidden in the UI. Server-side behaves like Enabled if. Empty = always visible.
schemaEdit.warningHint: Optional rule that produces a non-blocking warning when true or when it returns a non-empty string.
